continuation-H3-s4_outcome.mechanism: Accepted authoritative failure after completion latch; V04 split-finalization race
continuation-H3-s4_outcome.note: REPORT passes pending check before CmpOutcomeDeadline clears the barrier; completion reads/latches COMPLETED; active fail_run then writes authoritative rc=104 while running_jobs still contains the job; CmpPublish uses the old immutable latch. Source FS:933-957 and JR:484-492/525/817-843. Unlike deliberately ignored post-finality reports, fail_run records an active-job failure. Source review V04 reopened this interaction; this concrete counterexample is new to the continuation, distinct from historical MC-U1's inactive startup gap. Real deadline/handler scheduling and passing before-latch control remain required.
